title: Movie Maker checking the wrong directory for available disk space
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable & v4.6.dev.custom_build [https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/7ed0b6167618f9c8c5df87c7e83da6003c081368]

### System information

Arch Linux

### Issue description

Movie Maker warns when the available disk space is less than 10G.

However, the directory that it checks is not the one where the movie files will be located.

### Steps to reproduce

1. `cd` to somewhere that has less than 10G space left.
2. Run `godot --script mrp.gd --write-movie /path/where/available/disk/space/is/larger/than/10G.avi`

You can see output like this:

```
Movie Maker mode enabled, recording movie at 60 FPS...
WARNING: Current available space on disk is low (7.54 GiB). MovieWriter will fail during movie recording if the disk runs out of available space.
     at: begin (servers/movie_writer/movie_writer.cpp:124)
Space left: 52.70 GiB
```

In this example, the current working directory has 7.54 GiB left, and `--write-movie` points to a directory that has 52.70 GiB left.

It's checking the wrong directory.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```gdscript
extends SceneTree

func _initialize() -> void:
    var path := Engine.get_write_movie_path()
    if not path:
        printerr("Not writing movie")
        return
    var d := DirAccess.open(path.get_base_dir())
    print("Space left: ", String.humanize_size(d.get_space_left()))


func _process(delta: float) -> bool:
    return Engine.get_process_frames() > 16
```
